description: This is a Bash shell script for deploying OpenClaw to Kubernetes. It handles secret creation, secret management, deployment, and teardown of resources within a Kubernetes cluster, with command-line options for various deployment modes.

methods.name: _apply_secret
methods.description: Function to create or update the Kubernetes secret 'openclaw-secrets' with API keys and gateway token, generating a new token if it does not exist. Handles secret retrieval, creation, and updates.
